smoke_test.detail: Visible smoke escaping from brake booster supply hose where it joins the intake manifold. Hose surface shows longitudinal cracking.

vac_gauge_idle.detail: Steady but low manifold vacuum at idle, consistent with a fixed-size unmetered air entry.

trim_recheck_booster_hose_clamped.detail: With the leaking hose clamped, short-term fuel trim normalizes to ~+1% within seconds: the leak is isolated to that hose.
